description: This file defines a REST API controller named UsersController within the Conduit.Features.Users namespace, responsible for handling user creation and login endpoints using MediatR for request processing.

classes.name: UsersController
classes.description: A controller class handling user-related HTTP endpoints for creation and login, utilizing dependency injection for IMediator.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new user; delegates processing to the mediator with the Create.Command.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: Handles POST requests for user login; delegates processing to the mediator with the Login.Command.
